book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: All the saints greet you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

book_name: John’s Second Letter
text: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Thessalonians
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Be diligent to come to me soon,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to Timothy
text: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

book_name: John’s Third Letter
text: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

text: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Thus Paul went out from among them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They were about twelve men in all.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
text: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

book_name: The Acts of the Apostles
