text: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This will we do, if God permits.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: for our God is a consuming fire.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let brotherly love continue.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

book_name: The Letter to the Hebrews
text: Grace be with you all. Amen.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

book_name: The Letter from James
text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

book_name: The Letter from James
text: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

book_name: The Letter from James
text: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

book_name: The Letter from James
text: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

book_name: The Letter from James
text: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

book_name: The Letter from James
text: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

book_name: The Letter from James
text: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

book_name: The Letter from James
text: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The same was in the beginning with God.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Many more believed because of his word.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I don’t receive glory from men.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

book_name: The Good News According to John
